recentItems.title: Computing Power Steps into Daily Life at 2026 China Computational Power Conference
recentItems.description:
A range of cutting-edge applications, from underground parking navigation to unmanned retail and smart food preparation, showed how computing power empowers daily life and a wide range of industries at the 2026 China Computational Power Conference held from September 11 to 13 in Langfang City, north China's Hebei Province.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: BRICS Cooperation Opens up Prospect of Prosperity, Progress
recentItems.description:
As the BRICS cooperation mechanism is embarking on its third golden decade, a new chapter begins with China -- a rotating BRICS chair next year.

When addressing the Session I of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, India, Chinese President Xi Jinping said on September 12 that BRICS cooperation mechanism has become the world's most influential platform for cooperation among emerging markets and developing countries.
#China #India #BRICS2026
